description: Verify that Subscribe variant with TCP-only endpoint — DUT acks and emits event over TCP
approach:
[Objective]
TCP transport for events: Subscribe carries TCP endpoint; DUT must Ack and route subsequent events via TCP.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService with TCP endpoint.
2. Tester ⇄ DUT: TCP handshake.
3. Subscribe with TCP option → DUT Ack.
4. Trigger event → DUT emits event over TCP.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked TCP subscribe + emitted event — normal
